canvas.$description: App background behind panels and cards. Never put text-muted on it in dense tables; use surface.

surface.$description: Default panel, card, table and input background.

surface-raised.$description: Popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts. In dark mode elevation is shown by this lighter surface, not by shadow alone.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells, code blocks, table header row, segmented-control track.

surface-hover.$description: Hover background for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

surface-active.$description: Pressed background for rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

surface-selected.$description: Selected row, active nav item, selected menu item.

border-subtle.$description: Dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

border-strong.$description: Input, select, checkbox and secondary-button outlines. Holds 3:1 on surface and canvas.

text.$description: Primary text and headings on canvas, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders, table meta. 4.5:1 on every surface token.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast rules). Pair with a not-allowed cursor.

text-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover, success-solid, danger-solid, info-solid.

text-on-warning.$description: Text and icons on warning-solid (amber is too light for white).

accent.$description: Primary buttons, checked controls, progress, links in UI chrome. One primary action per view.

accent-soft.$description: Tinted background for accent badges, info-like highlights and selected chips.

accent-border.$description: Border of accent-tinted elements and hovered inputs.

accent-text.$description: Links and accent text on surface, canvas and accent-soft.

success-solid.$description: Solid success fill (badges, toasts, destructive buttons). Text on it: text-on-accent.

success-soft.$description: Tinted success background for alerts and soft badges.

success-border.$description: Border of success alerts; invalid-field border for danger.

success-text.$description: Success text and icons on surface, canvas and success-soft.

warning-solid.$description: Solid warning fill (badges, toasts, destructive buttons). Text on it: text-on-warning.

warning-soft.$description: Tinted warning background for alerts and soft badges.

warning-border.$description: Border of warning alerts; invalid-field border for danger.

warning-text.$description: Warning text and icons on surface, canvas and warning-soft.

danger-solid.$description: Solid danger fill (badges, toasts, destructive buttons). Text on it: text-on-accent.

danger-soft.$description: Tinted danger background for alerts and soft badges.

danger-border.$description: Border of danger alerts; invalid-field border for danger.

danger-text.$description: Danger text and icons on surface, canvas and danger-soft.

info-solid.$description: Solid info fill (badges, toasts, destructive buttons). Text on it: text-on-accent.

info-soft.$description: Tinted info background for alerts and soft badges.

info-border.$description: Border of info alerts; invalid-field border for danger.

info-text.$description: Info text and icons on surface, canvas and info-soft.

focus-ring.$description: 2px solid outline at 2px offset on every focusable element. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

chart-1.$description: First data series. Order series chart-1 to chart-5; never encode good/bad with chart colours.

space-2.$description: Gap between an icon and its label; between related inline items.

space-3.$description: Horizontal padding of md controls; gap between buttons.

space-4.$description: Card padding (compact), form-field gap, table cell horizontal padding.

radius-sm.$description: Badges, tooltips, menu items, table row highlight.

radius-md.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs (the default control radius).

radius-full.$description: Avatars, switches, status dots. Not for action buttons.
